title: Purpose and architecture
content:
Synthetic decoy DOCX
  -> unique external callback
  -> receiver records event
  -> scanner-aware triage
  -> console / SMTP decision
  -> persisted evidence
  -> optional DCR / Log Analytics
  -> scheduled Sentinel rule
  -> incident
meaning: Extended the local document-token receiver with Azure Table Storage and Sentinel ingestion. Word and cloud callbacks were exercised separately.

title: Starting state and baseline
meaning: Recorded the local SQLite starting point and nine passing baseline tests before adding the Azure adapters.

title: Infrastructure deployment
meaning: Deployed the Bicep resources successfully. Resource identifiers and endpoint values are omitted from the saved response.

title: Limitations and teardown status
content:
Deployment considerations:
- callback may be blocked or offline
- scanner requests can cause false positives
- source IP is not identity
- no automatic delivery retry worker
- rate limits, retention and integrity need deployment controls

Teardown was not performed.
meaning: Added the scoped teardown script but did not run it. Delivery retries, rate limiting, and integrity controls remained unfinished.
